hypothesis: Early CNN representations frozen in prior runs may limit task adaptation; test weight adaptation alone

changes.early_adapt: Add stem and encoder levels0/1 to trainable parameters at1e-5; existing levels2/3 remain1e-4 and original adapters/Swin1e-3

initialization: Same pinned ImageNet weights and deterministic fresh decoder initialization as Stage37; not warm-started from a selected segmentation checkpoint
architecture: Original MambaVision-S +64channel adapters +Swin decoder; no PointRend, no new blocks
encoder_mode: Entire encoder remains eval; BN running statistics fixed, stochastic depth disabled; gradients enabled for used stem and all4stages

batch.fallback: If batch64 fails capacity, stop before formal training and establish a matched control rather than silently change batch

target: Original normalized soft masks for BCE+softDice; threshold0.5 for common metrics
cache: Only normalized FP32 images and FP32 targets; no cached encoder features. Entire trainable forward recomputed each update.
selection: max validation per-image macro Dice, earliest exact tie
reference: Reuse Stage37 same4090,seed42,batch64,100cosine Swin baseline after full validation replay
test: Evaluate complete867 at fixed validation-selected weights; already-exposed test is not fresh confirmation
next: Replication only if screen passes; otherwise evaluate a standard decoder as separately specified experiment, no automated module sweep
caveats: Single seed learning-policy screen, not a novel segmentation method
Small early LR is prospectively chosen, not tuned against validation/test
No claim early features are already proven to be the bottleneck
